description: Structured educational reference data for terahertz wellness devices, terahertz spectrum education, terahertz versus infrared comparisons, beginner use, and related Holistix terahertz resources.
medical_disclaimer: This dataset is for educational and informational purposes only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, cure, prevention, or a substitute for professional healthcare guidance. Terahertz wellness technology is an emerging consumer category. Anyone who is pregnant, has an implanted medical device, has a serious health condition, takes prescription medication, or is unsure whether terahertz device use is appropriate should consult a qualified healthcare professional before use.

records.plain_language_summary: Terahertz wellness devices are an emerging consumer wellness technology category often discussed for targeted self-care routines.
records.educational_notes: Terahertz should be framed as an emerging wellness category, not as a medical treatment or cure.
records.safety_framing: Educational reference only. Not medical advice.

records.plain_language_summary: Terahertz refers to a part of the electromagnetic spectrum between microwave and infrared ranges.
records.educational_notes: Consumer wellness references should avoid overstating what terahertz devices can do and should explain the category conservatively.
records.safety_framing: Educational reference only. Spectrum education is not a treatment claim.

records.plain_language_summary: Terahertz and infrared are different parts of the electromagnetic spectrum and should not be treated as identical.
records.educational_notes: Infrared is commonly associated with heat-based wellness routines, while terahertz is a separate emerging category.
records.safety_framing: Avoid assuming different spectrum categories have the same use, effect, or safety profile.

records.plain_language_summary: Terahertz, red light, and infrared are separate spectrum categories with different consumer device contexts.
records.educational_notes: Red light is often discussed for skin-facing routines. Infrared is often discussed for heat or deeper exposure contexts. Terahertz is a separate emerging category.
records.safety_framing: Educational reference only. Device-specific instructions should guide use.

records.plain_language_summary: Handheld terahertz devices are designed for targeted at-home wellness sessions.
records.educational_notes: Device design, distance, session length, and user comfort should guide beginner use.
records.safety_framing: Start conservatively and follow device instructions. Stop use if discomfort occurs.

records.educational_notes: Product-specific use should be guided by the device instructions and user comfort.

records.plain_language_summary: Beginners should use terahertz wellness devices conservatively and avoid aggressive or prolonged use.
records.educational_notes: Short, conservative sessions are a safer starting point than long or intense routines.
records.safety_framing: Pregnancy, implanted medical devices, serious health conditions, or uncertainty should prompt consultation with a qualified professional.

records.plain_language_summary: Terahertz wellness devices should not be used as replacements for medical care.
records.educational_notes: Content should avoid claims that terahertz devices diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease.
